turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Confident, boastful control -- takes charge and delegates authority with joking swagger
turning_points.what_changes: Andy's swagger moves from lighthearted boasting and playful command over friends (winking about conning his dad for the boat) to hostile cursing directed at actual strangers on jet-skis, a clear rise in aggression/risk beyond anything shown in beat1.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Crude, aggressive provocation directed at outsiders perceived as a nuisance or threat
turning_points.what_changes: The same confrontation with the jet-skiers continues without a gap: as they circle back, Andy doesn't back down but orders John to gun the throttle and 'show 'em what she's got,' escalating the provocation from shouting into an active confrontational maneuver.
